name: Review geographic settings
title: Review geographic settings
description:
Review the active dataset and spatial lookup policy before entering locations. The install seeds a coarse Natural Earth world-country dataset; it is a generalized cartographic reference, not a legal boundary layer or detailed street map. Set the active dataset deliberately, check that online geocoding and tile fetching match your privacy policy, and prefer local/offline data where external disclosure is not approved.

The Motion Events tab holds the default event importance and the nearby-camera alert radius used when movement events are recorded. Use exact WGS84 decimal-degree coordinates (latitude −90…90, longitude −180…180). Do not round precise source coordinates. A blank active dataset or missing regional coverage is not fixed by creating a camera; import an authorized dataset first.
